headline: Suspected wartime device found at Bath Street, Millbay
summary: A suspected unexploded Second World War device has been found on a building site at Bath Street. A cordon is in place and nearby properties have been evacuated. Follow Plymouth City Council and Devon & Cornwall Police for official instructions.

updates.text: Cordon extended from 300m to 400m. A further 120 properties are affected.
Device confirmed as a German SC50 high-explosive bomb. Royal Navy EOD team on scene.
Major incident declared. An initial 100m cordon is in place and an evacuation centre has opened.
